name: Tobu Tobu Girl
author: Tangram Games (sound by potato-tan); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
license: MIT (game code, emulator), CC BY 4.0 (game graphics, text and music)
description: Tobu Tobu Girl, the 2017 Game Boy arcade platformer by Tangram Games: bounce on enemies to climb as high as you can before time runs out. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator (Peanut-GB) with sound, touch controls and gamepads; high scores are saved. Game by Tangram Games, code MIT, assets CC BY 4.0 (github.com/SimonLarsen/tobutobugirl).

descriptions.it: Tobu Tobu Girl, il platform arcade per Game Boy di Tangram Games (2017): rimbalza sui nemici per salire il piu' in alto possibile prima che scada il tempo. Gira sull'emulatore Game Boy integrato (Peanut-GB) con audio, comandi touch e gamepad; i record vengono salvati. Gioco di Tangram Games, codice MIT, grafica e musica CC BY 4.0 (github.com/SimonLarsen/tobutobugirl).
